info.title: Traigent TVL Reactive Contracts Routes
info.description: Closed wire contracts of the TVL 1.4 reactive layer (TRAIG-101, S1): evaluation-batch staging, producer watermarks, human approval grants, reservations, start authorization, effect outcome facts, cancel, attempt and notification read models. Reviewed closed-contract expansion (GNFR-PRIV-002(f)); see docs/tvl-reactive-contracts.md.

post.summary: Stage facts for one evaluation instant
post.description: TraigentBackend production reactive routes. Principals: P-ingest (SDK API key scoped to the agent) for customer-monitor and optimization-reporter facts; native-monitor facts are P-system only (403 fact_source_not_permitted). The tenant is resolved from the authenticated context (for a JWT session the backend's tenant resolution may consult X-Tenant-Id under its tenant rules); the path {project_id} is authorised against that tenant and the caller's project role, and bound into the request context by the project guard after authentication. Unknown body fields are refused. Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 {"success":false,"error":"reference_not_found","error_code":"reference_not_found","message":"Reference not found."} once the request reaches the feature gate, before authentication and before the route parses the body, indistinguishable from a missing or inaccessible reference (the global request-size guard runs earlier, so an oversized body can still get 413). Every error body, 429 included, is the closed envelope tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal; a 429 also carries a Retry-After header.
